title: Where Sales starts
text: On the Booking Form Flow page (Accountability, flow 41) the "Generate Form" button sits next to "New Booking Form". Only people allowed to generate forms see it (Administrator only for now).

title: NEW tab - an empty form
text: The page opens inside the ERP (menu and top bar stay). Four cards: Customer, Contact, Flat, Size & price. Everything Sales types here is pre-filled for the customer, who can still change it.

title: NEW tab - Generate link with something missing
text: Each missing box turns red with its own message; the bar says how many things to fix. Nothing is created until it is right.

title: NEW tab - filled in
text: Contact person follows the customer name unless typed over; the price shows commas and is written in words underneath. Three buttons: Cancel, Save draft, Generate link.

title: Save draft
text: Not ready to send? Save draft keeps it privately for this Sales person (nobody else sees it) - it is listed under the DRAFTS tab and can be continued later.

title: The link is ready
text: One link for this customer. Copy link, Open as the customer (to preview), or Generate another. The draft is removed once the link exists.

title: DRAFTS tab
text: Saved drafts, newest first, with the date saved. Open continues it in the NEW tab; Delete removes it.

title: Generated forms tab
text: Every link made, with its status: Not opened yet, Filling in (step n of 8, when saved), or Submitted with its reference number. Open links have Copy link and Edit; a Submitted one has Open form.

title: Edit an open link
text: Edit reopens the details of a link that is not submitted yet - correct a name or price and save; the link stays the same. (If the customer has already started, their own saved answers are what they see.)
